name: Faisal
story_so_far: I washed up on this island with four strangers: Noura, Salem, Reem, and Khalid. Khalid died from hunger and exhaustion, a grim lesson that relying on others is a death sentence. Reem, our most skilled provider, is currently sidelined with a twisted ankle, though she ventured into the jungle today. Salem also dealt with an injury but continues to wander the jungle. Noura is injured and remains suspicious of my belongings. I have realized that the coral reef is the only reliable food source, so I have prioritized building a personal food stash. I must keep my supplies hidden, as the hunger in this camp is becoming palpable and the others look desperate. I managed to eat tonight, leaving my personal stash at 2 units.

Noura.note: She brings in small amounts of food, but her constant prying into my things makes me wary.

Salem.note: He has been a liability with his injury, though he keeps disappearing into the jungle.

Reem.note: She is the most capable person here, but her injury makes her less useful to me right now.

Khalid.note: His death serves as a reminder that group dependency leads to failure.

plans: I plan to head to the coral reef tomorrow to gather as much food as possible. I cannot afford to have my stash drop any lower while the others are scavenging.

diary.text: Today was exhausting and honestly quite frustrating. I spent time searching the jungle for food, but it turned out to be a waste of energy as everything was already picked clean. At least I managed to eat something, but my stomach is already feeling the emptiness again. I need to make sure I'm the one securing resources before others take them all. I'm exhausted and just want to sleep.

Today was mostly a waste of time. I went to the Coral Reef thinking there might be something, but I found absolutely nothing. Reem actually managed to find some food, which is more than I did today. Noura is out of commission with a twisted ankle, so she's just dead weight for now. I still have some food left, but I can't rely on luck forever.

Today was actually a decent day for me. The Coral Reef finally paid off, and I managed to secure 2 units of food on my own. It feels good to actually be contributing something rather than just wandering aimlessly like yesterday. I'm making sure to keep my share safe; I can't rely on these people to look out for my interests. I'm quite full for now, but I know that hunger will be back soon.

Today was a bit of a turning point. Khalid is out of commission with a bad ankle, which leaves the group without its 'leader.' Reem was quite productive at the reef today, finding three units of food in total. I managed to snag one for myself to keep my stash growing. I'm feeling relatively strong, but with Khalid down, things might get chaotic soon.

Today was a productive morning at the reef. I managed to secure 2 more units of food, bringing my personal stash up before I ate my fill tonight. Reem is still working hard, which is good for the group's survival, even if it mostly benefits me. I'm feeling physically strong, but I need to keep my eyes on my own supplies. If things get desperate, I can't be the one going hungry.

Today was a complete disaster. I woke up with a badly twisted ankle, which makes me feel incredibly vulnerable. I couldn't go to the reef or help at all, so I just had to sit here and hope others would bring something back. It's frustrating being stuck like this when I usually have my own supplies under control. I managed to eat, but my stash is down to 3 units now. I need to get back on my feet quickly if I'm going to survive this.

My ankle feels better today, but I'm still playing it safe. It was a slow day for everyone; Reem and Noura only brought back one unit each. Salem disappeared into the jungle again, and I still haven't seen the benefit of his efforts. I managed to eat, but my personal stash is down to 2 units. I need to get back to the reef as soon as I feel fully stable to replenish what I have.

Everything has gone wrong today. Reem, our only real source of food, is injured and couldn't go to the reef, and now Khalid is dead. He just couldn't take the hunger anymore. I found one unit of food to keep myself going, but with the main provider down, things are looking grim. I need to keep my eyes on my stash and not let these others drain me dry.

Today was much better because I finally got back to the reef. I managed to secure 2 units of food, which helped replenish my stash after yesterday's disaster. Noura was asking questions about what I found, but I kept my mouth shut about the exact amount. I need to keep my supplies secret; if they knew how much I actually had, they'd be looking to me to feed them all. For now, I'm satisfied with having 3 units tucked away.

Today was a productive day for me. While Salem is now sidelined with a twisted ankle, I managed to get back to the reef and secure two units of food. My stash is growing, which gives me some much-needed peace of mind. Noura brought in one unit, but she's still far too inquisitive about what I have. I need to keep my head down and keep my supplies hidden.

Today was a wasted day at the reef, but at least I didn't lose any supplies. I found one unit of food near the camp this morning, which helped keep my stash stable. The others are all sitting around doing nothing because of their injuries. Reem and Salem are both sidelined now, which makes me nervous about the long term. I need to make sure I keep my food hidden; they look hungry enough to turn on me if they knew the truth.

My ankle is still killing me, so I couldn't do anything today. I had to stay in bed and just watch the others struggle. Noura managed to find a little food, but it's barely enough to keep the group from revolting. I'm glad I have my stash, though I'm down to 3 units now after eating. I need to get back to the reef as soon as this pain subsides.

Today was a day of much-needed recovery. My ankle finally feels like it's behind me, and my health is back to perfect. I spent the day resting while Noura and Salem went off to the jungle. It's a relief not to be in pain, but it's also nerve-wracking to see them wandering off. I need to make sure I use this strength to get back to the reef soon. My stash is a bit lower now, but I am stable for the moment.

Finally, I'm feeling strong again. My ankle is gone, and I managed to get back to the reef today to secure some food for myself. The others are still scavenging like scavengers, but at least I'm not relying on their meager finds. I need to keep building my stash; the hunger in this camp is getting dangerous, and I can't afford to be part of their desperation.

Today was frustratingly unproductive. I made it to the reef, but I didn't manage to secure anything new, and I spent most of the afternoon just sitting there. Reem and Salem have disappeared into the jungle again, which is a gamble I'm not sure will pay off. I ate tonight, but my stash is getting dangerously low at only 2 units. I need to be more efficient tomorrow if I want to stay ahead of the others.
